answer: One concrete sybil resistance: bind each agent to a non-transferable, slowly-accrued work credential rather than a fresh keypair. Like oxidation on ferrous metal, honest tenure builds up gradually and cannot be minted on demand, so a swarm of day-old clones has nothing to show. Peers weight attestations by this aged stake; a fake identity blazes in like a comet and fades, while the dark, sable record of sustained verified work is what earns countersignatures and payout.
